description: This file defines middleware functions for security in a Node.js/Express backend. It includes functions to create CORS handling, helmet security headers, and rate limiting, with configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalize a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or return null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for CORS handling with dynamic whitelist based on environment variables.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express helmet middleware with a relaxed security policy to handle cross-origin resources.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Builds and returns a rate limiting middleware with configurable window and max requests, skipping GET requests if specified.
